deep.reconstruction: This page contains no mathematics and is not by Riemann. It is a handwritten German archival note, dated 29.10.86 and signed by a later librarian or archivist (the signature appears to read 'H. Rohlf...', plausibly H. Rohlfing of the Göttingen manuscript department). It is filed with the Riemann Nachlass under the heading 'Zu Riemann 13'. Translation: 'Re Riemann 13. The fair copy (Reinschrift) of Riemann's dissertation "Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Funktionen einer veränderlichen komplexen Größe", 35 pp. quarto (1851), was bought at a Sotheby's auction in 1979 (Honeyman Collection) by a private individual for £1,400. See American Book Prices Current 1979, p. 1014.' Further marks: the folio number '12a' in the right margin, and a shelf or provenance note at bottom right, 'V 11 – Paris 1979, 1986'. The next page is a second, nearly identical copy of the same note dated 25.11.86. The note serves provenance purposes: it records that the clean copy of the 1851 doctoral dissertation (Göttingen) is in private hands rather than in the Nachlass. There is no derivation to reconstruct.
errors: No mathematical errors, since there is no mathematics. Bibliographic remarks: the note modernizes the spelling of the title; the 1851 original reads 'Functionen' and 'complexen Grösse'. The page count (35 S.) and price (£1,400) differ from the next-page transcription ('31 S.', '£11000'). The image of this page clearly shows '35 S.' and '£ 1.400', so the discrepancy is most likely a transcription error on the next page rather than a disagreement between the two notes.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a 1986 librarian's provenance note about the auction sale of the dissertation manuscript. It contains no mathematics by Riemann. The Honeyman science-library sales at Sotheby's (1978–81) are well documented.
transcription_corrections: The signature most plausibly reads 'H. Rohlf...' (likely H. Rohlfing); the trailing '[?]' is appropriate.
In 'American Book Prices Current 1979', the final digit appears overwritten (possibly 8 corrected to 9); '1979' is the intended reading.
The struck-out word after 'veränderlichen' is a cancelled start, plausibly 'Gr' (anticipating 'Größe'), rewritten on the next line as 'Komplexen Größe'.
The page image confirms '35 S. 4°' and '£ 1.400'. The next-page transcription ('31 S.', '£ 11000') is probably misread and should be checked against its image.
'12a' in the right margin is the archival folio number, not part of the note's text.
